name: 꼬모 뒤 업힐·다운힐
about: 꼬모 뒤 업힐·다운힐, third layout (11-15; user: "업힐 다운힐도 … 너무 쉬워졌는데 좀 코스 어렵게 해주고", "코너 커브를 많이 늘려서 어렵게"): the lakeside path and the climb past Como as before, then a winding 4 m grey asphalt mountain road - four esses across the lawn below the Woomi towers, two switchbacks up the main hill's north face, esses over the summit (40 m), a steep descent down its south-west ridge into a hairpin, a traverse of the west flank to a hairpin by the lowland walkways, and the old lowland road along the walkway to the lake. Laid by tools/courses/hill_road.py from tools/courses/specs/hill3.json.
